name: Button
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Button(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
Variants
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-3") do
    (UI::Button::VARIANTS.keys - [ :light ]).each do |variant|
      Button(variant:) { variant.to_s.humanize }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` scales height, padding, radius and icon size.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3") do
    [ :sm, :md, :lg ].each { |size| Button(size:) { size.to_s.upcase } }
  end
end

examples.name: Icon buttons
examples.notes: `icon: true` makes a square button; give it an `aria_label:`.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3") do
    [ :sm, :md, :lg ].each do |size|
      Button(variant: :soft, size:, icon: true, aria_label: "Bookmark") do
        Icon(:bookmark)
      end
    end
  end
end
